questions.prompt: A second barrel is more attractive when…

choices.text: The turn helps your betting range or you still have real equity.
The turn completes the caller’s draw and you have air

questions.explanation: Barrel cards that improve you or pressure exactly the hands that called the flop.

choices.text: You checked the flop and bet the turn.
You bet the flop and the turn and the river without looking
You fold the turn after betting the flop

questions.explanation: Checking back the flop and betting a helpful turn is a delayed c-bet, not a second barrel.

questions.prompt: Checking the turn with showdown value is right when…

choices.text: A bet would mostly be called by better and fold out worse.
You have a draw that must charge
The pot is heads-up and you are facing an all-in

questions.explanation: Thin hands that are ahead of air and behind value want a check, not a bloated pot.

questions.prompt: Turn size should consider the river because…

choices.text: A large turn bet can set up an all-in river or leave you committed.
The river is not a street
You must always leave exactly one big blind behind

questions.explanation: Do not bet a size on the turn that you hate when called. Plan the stack.
